metadata.title: Eye Learn: See it. Learn it. Remember it.
metadata.description: Eye Learn helps you build a consistent study habit with visual flashcards, AI-generated cards, and progress tracking.

hero.headline: See it. Study it. Remember it.
hero.subheadline: Eye Learn turns your notes into visual flashcards, keeps you coming back with study streaks, and helps difficult subjects finally click.
hero.ctaHint: Free to start. No credit card required.

valueProp.title: Studying, rebuilt around how you actually remember
valueProp.subtitle: Eye Learn combines visual flashcards, active recall, and AI to make studying feel less like a chore.

0.title: Learn visually
0.description: See concepts as cards, highlights, and images instead of walls of text. Built for people who remember what they see.

1.title: Powered by AI
1.description: Turn your notes into ready-to-study flashcards in seconds, so you spend your time studying instead of formatting.

2.title: Built on active recall
2.description: Every card asks you to remember, not just re-read. It's the study technique proven to make information stick.

howItWorks.title: How Eye Learn works
howItWorks.subtitle: Three simple steps between you and a subject that finally makes sense.

0.title: Add your material

1.title: Let AI build your cards
1.description: Eye Learn turns your material into clear, visual flashcards ready for active recall practice.

2.title: Study a little every day
2.description: Short daily sessions, streaks, and progress tracking keep you consistent. That's the real key to remembering.

aiFeature.title: Turn any notes into flashcards, instantly
aiFeature.description: Stop spending hours formatting study material. Paste your notes or textbook excerpts and Eye Learn drafts a full set of flashcards you can refine and start studying right away.

points.0: Generates question-and-answer pairs from your own notes
points.1: Groups cards into sets by subject or exam automatically
points.2: Study your way: tap-to-reveal, multiple-choice, or type-the-answer cards
points.3: You stay in control: edit, reorder, or regenerate any card

streakShowcase.title: Small daily sessions build a habit that sticks
streakShowcase.description: Eye Learn tracks your study streak so a few focused minutes a day turn into real, lasting progress. It's the same consistency mechanics that make habits stick, without the busywork.

productPreview.title: A closer look at studying with Eye Learn
productPreview.subtitle: A preview of the study experience we're building: flashcard sets, streaks, and progress tracking working together.

benefits.title: Why people choose Eye Learn
benefits.subtitle: Everything about Eye Learn is built to make studying easier to start and easier to stick with.

0.title: Visual learning
0.description: See ideas as cards and highlights instead of dense paragraphs. Easier to picture, easier to recall.

1.title: AI-generated flashcards
1.description: Skip the busywork of making cards by hand and get straight to studying.

2.title: Study streaks
2.description: A visible streak keeps you coming back, turning studying into a habit instead of a scramble.

3.title: Progress tracking
3.description: See exactly how far you've come on each subject, so you always know what to study next.

4.title: Personalized roadmaps
4.description: Set a target date to master a subject and Eye Learn breaks it into a clear study plan to get you there.

5.title: Multiple study modes
5.description: Practice the way that helps you remember best: tap-to-reveal, multiple-choice, or type-the-answer.

6.title: Exam-ready sets
6.description: Organize cards into sets by subject or exam, so nothing gets lost between classes.

7.title: Bite-sized sessions
7.description: A few focused minutes a day beats a single long cram session. Eye Learn is built around that.

goalIntro.title: Study goals, one collection at a time
goalIntro.description: Pick a date you want to have mastered a collection by. Eye Learn works out exactly how many cards you need to study each day to get there, no manual math.
goalIntro.benefit1: See a clear daily target instead of an overwhelming pile of cards
goalIntro.benefit2: Your daily target adjusts automatically as the deadline gets closer
goalIntro.benefit3: Set independent goals per collection, so exam prep and hobby subjects don't compete
goalIntro.howTo: Open any collection and tap its "Goal" button to set a target date.
